fb.title: FB Info Lookup
fb.shortDescription: Paste a Facebook profile/page link to quickly extract username, numeric ID, and public metadata.
fb.metaDescription: Extract username, global ID (numeric), and public info from a Facebook profile or fanpage link.
fb.shortcutHint: Tip: press Enter to look up.
fb.limitationsBody: Facebook restricts automated access. This tool will always return username and numeric ID when present in the URL; name/photo/description are best-effort — Facebook sometimes serves a login wall instead. Private info (city, work, education...) requires user OAuth and cannot be fetched here.
fb.noResultYet: No result yet. Paste a link and hit Lookup.
fb.loadingHint: Fetching info from Facebook, hang tight...
fb.legitAdLibraryHint: Opens Meta Ad Library — shows page creation date, admin country, name change history (if any), and all active ads. The most reliable way to verify a page's legitimacy.
fb.legitAboutHint: Opens the About page — FB sometimes shows extended Page Transparency with name history in the sidebar.
fb.trustEngagementLow: Very low engagement ({rate}%) — possible fake followers or dormant page
fb.trustEngagementHigh: Unusually high engagement ({rate}%) — watch out for spam bots or fake activity
fb.trustUsernameMatch: Username matches display name — unlikely to be recently renamed
fb.trustUsernameMismatch: Username DIFFERS from display name — page may have been renamed
fb.trustNewPageActor: Actor ID starts with 100... — page was created after 2020 (newer page)
fb.trustMissingAbout: Page has {likes} likes but NO About section — unusual
fb.trustSuspiciousKeyword: Name contains "{word}" — common in fake/spam pages
fb.trustNoCategory: Page has no category — incomplete profile or dormant
fb.trustManualCheck1: Page creation date (new <6 months + selling = high risk)
fb.trustManualCheck2: Admin country (Vietnamese-language page with foreign admin = suspicious)
fb.trustManualCheck3: Name change history (3+ renames in 1 year = red flag)
fb.trustManualCheck4: Active ads (real businesses usually run ads)
fb.errorInvalidUrl: Invalid URL. Must be a Facebook link.
fb.errorParseFailed: Could not recognize this Facebook URL pattern.
fb.errorFbBlocked: Facebook blocked the request. Only URL-derived info is available.
fb.errorRateLimited: Too many lookups. Please retry in {seconds}s.
fb.errorUnknown: Failed to fetch info. Try again later.

shopee.thanks: Thanks for using this tool — if you purchase through this link, I'll get a small commission to keep the blog running 🙏

shopee.errorExpandFailed: Could not expand the shortlink. Try the full product URL instead.

shopee.errorNotShopee: URL must be a shopee.vn / shp.ee link.

shopee.errorRateLimited: Too many submissions. Please retry in {seconds}s.
